title: Flatten all -L search paths into a single list of files

target.summary: `get_object_file_path` searches for object files using `get_file_candidates`, but `FileSearch` only pre-filters and indexes files starting with library prefixes (`lib`, `staticlib_prefix`, `dll_prefix`). Object files without these prefixes (such as CRT objects like `crt*.o`) will never be found in search paths, causing linker failures.
notes: faulty call to get_file_candidates for object file lookup
definition of get_file_candidates called by get_object_file_path
pre-filtering in FileSearch::new that discards non-library files like crt*.o
